description: Defines classes and functions for Huffman decoding in HPACK, including HuffmanBitBuffer and HpackHuffmanDecoder, used for incremental Huffman decoding of strings in HTTP/2 HPACK compression.

classes.name: HuffmanBitBuffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer of bits for Huffman decoding, allowing appending bytes, consuming bits, and checking termination.

classes.name: HpackHuffmanDecoder
classes.description: Performs incremental Huffman decoding of HPACK-encoded strings, maintaining internal bit buffer state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the HuffmanBitBuffer or HpackHuffmanDecoder to initial state.

methods.name: AppendBytes
methods.description: Adds bytes to the HuffmanBitBuffer, returning the number of bytes added.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a portion of a Huffman-encoded string, appending decoded symbols to output.

methods.name: InputProperlyTerminated
methods.description: Checks if the remaining bits in the buffer are properly terminated according to RFC.
